# Mesh study for the wing case

## Answer

The medium mesh is fine enough for drag. Its drag differs from the coarse mesh by 0.8%.

## Results

The fine mesh has 2.1 million cells. The study compared drag on the coarse, medium and
fine meshes. The grid convergence index met the target the project set.

## Open questions

- Is the first cell close enough to the wall on the fine mesh? Nobody has run the wall
  distance check yet.
